description: This file is a BitBake recipe or include file for building the rxvt-unicode terminal emulator within an embedded Linux build system, defining build dependencies, configuration options, and install steps.

methods.name: do_configure:prepend
methods.description: Prepares the build system by copying aclocal.m4 to acinclude.m4 if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: do_compile:prepend
methods.description: Defines compile-time macros for xterm configuration related to files such as utmp, wtmp, and locale support.

methods.name: do_install:append
methods.description: Handles installation of icons and desktop files into the image.
